content: Implement QIF v0.6.25 Evaluator Packet CLI so humans, independent evaluators, AI agents, and audit harnesses can request a single machine-readable handoff packet before reviewing QIF. The packet should compose commands, package-types, inventory, status, review-plan, release-ready, and open-risk signals into scope, freshness, evidence refs, required commands, unresolved-risk prompts, and trust boundaries without claiming semantic quality truth or independent approval.
